title: SNACK JSON output envelope
description: The document every `--json` invocation writes to stdout. Frozen at 0.9: the named fields do not change meaning or disappear without a major release. Version 2 renamed the `config set` storage keys to snake_case; a version 1 document declares itself as such and does not pass here, which is what makes the break visible instead of silent.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope contract. Additive fields do not bump it; a removal or a changed meaning does. Pinned rather than merely well-formed, so a document from an earlier version fails loudly here instead of validating as something it is not.

command.description: The command that produced the document, as the user would type it after `snack`.

generated_at.description: When the document was produced, from the injected clock.

status.description: Whether the command answered fully, answered with something degraded, or failed.

data.description: The command's payload, or null when there is none to give.

diagnostics.description: Always present, empty when there is nothing to report, so a consumer never has to distinguish absent from empty.
